🇮🇷 ⚔️ 🇮🇱 IDF on high alert for ‘Iranian surprise attack’, planning new ‘preemptive strike’ – reports 🗣 “The possibility that Iran will try to surprise Israel is a reasonable scenario. To that end, the IDF needs to be prepared for defense and attack,” a senior security source told Israel’s Hebrew-language Walla News. The IDF and US military are said to be coordinating extremely closely, with “thousands” of US troops now stationed in Israel, including at a secret government bunker under Tel Aviv, and the Israeli military, especially the Air Force, maintaining “high levels of readiness…alongside reinforcements in operational command centers and 27/7 HQs, for any scenario to shorten response times,” the outlet said. The IDF’s Intelligence Directorate has reportedly been working to “refine” its regional early-warning models to ensure “that should Iran decide to launch a surprise attack against US interests in the Middle East…the IDF would have sufficient time to prepare, or if necessary even launch a preemptive strike.” Walla also says US cargo aircraft have been shuttling back and forth to Israeli bases in recent weeks to deliver equipment for “thousands” of personnel amid Israeli claims that Iran is working on chemical weapons. Iran’s foreign minister has dismissed the claims as “rubbish,” and accused Israel of trying to pull Washington into a new war. 👉 Walla’s reporting comes amid an intensification of efforts to blame Iran for an array of global security incidents , from charges that it hacked France’s grocery store refrigerators, to claims it targeted Kuwaiti military installations this week. Iranian officials have dismissed the claims, and accused enemies of trying to trigger a new round of fighting, and to bring new countries into the war. The uptick in ‘surprise attack’, false flag and ‘preemptive strike’ talk comes amid reports that the Trump administration is again considering an attack on Iran , and that many of his top officials are now living in fortified military compounds . 👍 Substack | Chat | @geopolitics_prime
